name: AI Post Summarizer Lite for WordPress
author: R.Sabbir

sections.description:
The easiest way to add an AI button to summarize your WordPress blog content — no API key, no subscriptions, no server costs. 100% free.

AI Post Summarizer Lite allows you to easily content summarize any article by adding a beautiful one-click “Summarize with AI” button to your posts. When a reader clicks it, they instantly get a concise TLDR (Too Long; Didn’t Read) summary of your article powered by ChatGPT or Google AI — all without you needing a single API key or paid subscription.

It just works. Install it, activate it, and your readers can instantly summarize long articles using the world’s most trusted AI platforms.

Looking to summarize with Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or Grok?
✨ Upgrade to Pro — 60% OFF Limited Offer!

⚡ Why Bloggers Love This AI Summarizer

  • Zero API Keys Required — Works out of the box. No OpenAI account, no Google Cloud setup, nothing.
  • Zero Cost to You — All AI processing happens in the user’s browser. Your hosting bill stays exactly the same.
  • Zero Privacy Risk — Your content is never sent to our servers. 100% GDPR compliant.
  • Works With Any Theme — Fully responsive and designed to blend seamlessly with any WordPress theme.
  • WordPress 7.0 Ready — Fully tested and compatible with the latest WordPress release.

🎯 Key Features to Content Summarize

  • One-Click AI Summaries — Readers click once and get an instant AI-generated TLDR in a new tab.
  • ChatGPT Integration — Powered by OpenAI’s ChatGPT, the world’s most popular AI assistant.
  • Google AI Integration — Full support for Google’s AI, perfect for users who prefer Google’s ecosystem.
  • Floating Action Button (FAB) — A sleek floating button follows readers as they scroll, always within reach.
  • Smart Button Positioning — Display the button before content, after content, or both.
  • Multiple Button Styles — Choose between square, rounded, and pill-style button designs.
  • Size Controls — Independent controls for label size and button size (Small, Medium, Large).
  • Lightweight & Performance-Optimized — Assets load only on single post pages. Zero impact on page speed scores.
  • Translation Ready — Fully internationalized and ready for any language.

🔒 How It Works (It’s Surprisingly Simple)

  1. The plugin adds a branded “Summarize with AI” button to your posts.
  2. When a visitor clicks it, the plugin builds a smart prompt containing your post’s title and content.
  3. That prompt opens in a new tab inside ChatGPT or Google AI.
  4. The AI reads it and generates a TLDR summary — instantly.

No data ever touches your server. No API calls. No background processes. Just a smart link that opens in the user’s browser.

🔐 Privacy & GDPR Compliance

AI Post Summarizer Lite is designed with privacy as the foundation:

  • No data collection — We do not collect, track, or store any visitor data.
  • No cookies — Zero tracking scripts or cookies are used.
  • No third-party transmissions — Your content never leaves the user’s browser.
  • Client-side only — All processing happens locally on the visitor’s device.

This plugin is fully GDPR, CCPA, and PECR compliant.

📊 Technical Specifications

Requirements:
* WordPress 6.0 or higher (tested up to 7.0)
* PHP 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.0+ recommended)

Performance:
* Loads assets conditionally — only on single post pages
* Zero external HTTP requests from your server
* Minimal code footprint — no bloat
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “AI Post Summarizer”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to AI Summarizer in your sidebar to configure your settings.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate Plugin.
  5. Go to AI Summarizer in your sidebar to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key or any paid subscription?

Absolutely not. This is the biggest advantage of this plugin. It works by sending your post content directly to ChatGPT or Google AI through the user’s browser — no API keys, no accounts, no monthly fees needed on your end.

Can my users summarize with Claude?

To content summarize with Claude, you will need to upgrade to the Pro version. The Lite version supports ChatGPT and Google AI, while Pro adds Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok.

Is this plugin really 100% free?

Yes, completely free with no hidden costs. The Lite version will always remain free. We offer a Pro version for users who need advanced AI platforms like Claude, design tools, and analytics.

Will this slow down my website?

No — in fact, it has virtually zero impact on performance. The plugin only loads its small CSS and JS files on single post pages, and it makes zero server-side requests. Your PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals scores will not be affected.

Does it work with my page builder (Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder)?

Yes. The plugin hooks into WordPress’s standard the_content filter and works with all major page builders and themes.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin can be configured to display on any post type, including WooCommerce product pages.

What is the difference between Lite and Pro?

The Lite version is perfect for bloggers and small sites that want to offer ChatGPT and Google AI summaries. The Pro version is a complete toolkit adding Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, a 20+ style design engine, smart prompt templates, per-post customization, analytics, and priority support.

Does the AI summary get stored or cached?

No. A new summary is generated fresh each time a user clicks the button. Nothing is stored on your server or in your database.

Is the plugin compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WordPress Multisite installations.

How do I get the 60% discount on Pro?

Visit AI Post Summarizer Pro — the discount is applied automatically at checkout. You’ll get instant access to all Pro features, advanced AI platforms, and priority support.
